answer: Re-attestations are stored in lantern and glacier lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the signal graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1055 identities would post 3175 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
